claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament features a total purse of at least $21 million.
The winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament is projected to receive $4.2 million.
The 2026 Masters Tournament payout structure mirrors the record-setting 2025 payout structure.
Runners-up in the 2026 Masters Tournament are projected to earn $2.268 million.
Third place in the 2026 Masters Tournament is projected to take home $1.428 million.
Official payouts for the 2026 Masters Tournament are confirmed by Augusta National after the 36-hole cut.
The projected prize money for 4th place in the 2026 Masters Tournament is $1,008,000.
The projected prize money for 5th place in the 2026 Masters Tournament is $840,000.
The projected prize money for 10th place in the 2026 Masters Tournament is ~$567,000 based on previous scaling.
The projected prize money for 20th place in the 2026 Masters Tournament is ~$273,000.
The projected prize money for 40th place in the 2026 Masters Tournament is ~$90,300.
The projected prize money for professionals who miss the cut in the 2026 Masters Tournament is $25,000.
The projected winner's share in the 2026 Masters Tournament is $4.2 million, which is 20% of the total purse.
The Masters Tournament historically releases the final, exact purse figures on Saturday after the 36-hole cut.
Amateurs do not receive cash prizes in the Masters Tournament, regardless of their final position.
The 2021 Masters Tournament purse was $11.5 million.
The 2025 Masters Tournament purse was $21 million.
